notes: The mother's recall, asked about a child born into the panel (UKHLS at her next interview after the birth), from the cross-wave person file (joined to the youth in the tidier, so the same on every wave): 'Was [child] born within one week of the expected due date?' (BHPS bwtxp_bh, UKHLS bwtxp), then 'early or late?' (bwtel_bh, bwtel) and how many weeks (bwtwk_bh, bwtwk; UKHLS wording of items taken from BHPS, half weeks rounded up). 4 or more weeks early = TRUE; within a week of the due date, late, or 1-3 weeks early = FALSE; early with no weeks = NA. Partial: the whole-week answer forces the cut, so a birth a little over 3 weeks early can count as FALSE. BHPS taken where both surveys recorded one.
